summary: The region filter matches substrings instead of exact values.
root_cause: filterByRegion uses String.prototype.includes, so prefix regions also match.

claims.text: The observed dataset contains eight rows instead of four.
The rendered chart shows duplicated quarter labels.

candidate.unified_diff:
diff --git a/apps/demo-chart/src/filterData.ts b/apps/demo-chart/src/filterData.ts

+++ b/apps/demo-chart/src/filterData.ts
